annotations.title: Pricing, margin vs markup + discount impact

description: Pricing, margin vs markup + discount impact — Price and margin math for sellers: cost plus price, target_margin (%) or markup (%). Returns margin vs markup, unit profit, break-even price and a price ladder for 20-80% margins. Optional: discount (%) → new margin and how much unit sales must rise to keep the same gross profit; price_increase (%) → how far sales can fall before profit drops; fee_pct + fee_fixed (payment or marketplace fees per sale, e.g. 2.9 and 0.30) included in margins; tax_pct → price with tax; units → revenue, profit and units needed. Offline, instant. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
